chapter_policy: One named teacher leads a chapter. Alternate female and male teacher leads across subsequent chapters; retain the same clear modelling, warmth and mathematical authority for both. Future assignments remain editorial proposals.

teachers.name: Mrs Binta
teachers.role: Patient primary teacher who models an action, practises with the class, then asks pupils to recall and demonstrate it. Display title Mrs Binta at the user's request; internal stable ID retained.

teachers.name: Mr Aliyu
teachers.role: Warm, confident male teacher introduced as the next chapter's lead; welcomes the children's ideas.
teachers.visual: Cream long-sleeved native kaftan and trousers, muted green neckline/chest embroidery, embroidered cream-and-green cap and brown shoes. Hausa-inspired styling at the user's request; no claim of universal or certified authentic attire.

fictional_status: Fictional individuals. Names and clothes do not establish ethnicity, faith or a universal local teaching style.
